summary: Frontend testing of S.T.E.W.A.R.D. Workspace advanced window management features completed successfully. All three phases tested: Phase 1 (Pin & Focus Mode), Phase 2 (Edge Snap), Phase 3 (Magnetism). All features working correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: DraggableModule.jsx: Pin mode cycling (none->lock->top->none) implemented correctly with proper color states
DraggableModule.jsx: Lock mode (pinMode === 'lock') correctly prevents dragging by returning early from handleMouseDown
DraggableModule.jsx: Top mode correctly sets zIndex to 9999 via inline style
DraggableModule.jsx: Focus mode correctly dims other windows to opacity 0.4 via isDimmed state
DraggableModule.jsx: ESC key listener properly clears focus mode
DraggableModule.jsx: getSnapZone() correctly detects edge and corner zones with 50px threshold
DraggableModule.jsx: getMagneticPosition() correctly implements 15px threshold for edge alignment
Canvas.jsx: SnapPreview component correctly renders cyan overlay with Czech labels
WorkspaceContext.js: snapToLayout() correctly calculates and applies snap positions/sizes
context_for_next_testing_agent: Advanced window management features fully tested. Pin button cycles through 3 states with correct colors. Focus mode dims other windows. Edge snap works for all zones (left-half, right-half, maximized, corners). Magnetism snaps windows together when edges within 15px.
features_tested: ✅ Pin button cycles: none (gray) -> lock (orange) -> top (purple) -> none
✅ Lock mode (orange): Window cannot be moved - position unchanged after drag attempt
✅ Top mode (purple): z-index set to 9999, window stays on top even when clicking other windows
✅ Border color changes: cyan (none), orange (lock), purple (top)
✅ Double-click on window header enters focus mode
✅ Other windows dim to 40% opacity (verified: opacity changed from 1 to 0.4)
✅ ESC key exits focus mode (verified: opacity returned to 1)
✅ Left edge snap: Cyan preview with 'Levá polovina' label, snaps to left half (width 768px)
✅ Right edge snap: Cyan preview with 'Pravá polovina' label, snaps to right half (x=800, width 768px)
✅ Top edge snap: Cyan preview with 'Maximalizovat' label, maximizes window (width 1568px, height 968px)
✅ Top-left corner snap: Cyan preview with 'Vlevo nahoře' label, snaps to quarter size (768x468px)
✅ Horizontal magnetism: When dragging window edge within 15px of another window, edges snap together (0px gap verified)
✅ Magnetism only triggers when not in edge snap zone (correct priority)
mocked_apis_note: Entire app uses localStorage for persistence - no backend API calls
